Solutions - Eight Service Areas

Explore AICORE's eight solution pillars: AI systems, process automation, IoT, embedded firmware, robotics, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, and developer tools.

AI Systems & AI Tools: Custom AI assistants, AI APIs, and intelligent workflow tools built for real business operations.

Process & Business Automation: Workflow automation that removes manual steps and connects your tools, data, and teams.

Intelligent Platforms & SaaS: Secure multi-tenant software products — from MVPs to launch-ready SaaS platforms.

Embedded, IoT & Edge AI: Connect physical devices to cloud intelligence — firmware, IoT gateways, sensor networks, and edge AI.

Robotics & Intelligent Hardware: Practical robotics, control systems, and intelligent hardware solutions for real-world use.

Developer Tools & Engineering Utilities: Firmware testing rigs, protocol analyzers, simulation environments, and engineering CLI tools.

Mobile & Cross-Platform Apps: Connected mobile applications for field operations, IoT monitoring, inspections, and business workflows.

AICORE Academy: Practical technical training in AI, automation, embedded systems, robotics, and IoT for individuals and organizations.

Which AICORE solution should we start with? Start with the highest-friction workflow or system constraint. AICORE can assess your process, data, devices, and users, then recommend whether AI, automation, IoT, SaaS, mobile, or embedded systems is the right first step.

Can AICORE combine multiple service areas in one project? Yes. Many projects combine software, AI, automation, embedded devices, dashboards, and mobile apps. AICORE is built for complete intelligent system delivery rather than isolated single-discipline work.

Do you build MVPs or production systems? We build both. We can validate an MVP quickly, then harden it into a secure, maintainable production system with deployment, monitoring, documentation, and support.

Can you work with an existing team or system? Yes. AICORE can extend existing platforms, integrate with current tools, modernise legacy workflows, or co-build alongside your internal technical team.
